ai.literal: To those who wage war even, a fortress is an asset; fearing for oneself, to those who protect even, it is an asset.
ai.translation: A fortress is a valuable asset to those who wage war, and equally an asset to those who fearfully protect themselves.
ai.modern: படையெடுத்துப் போர் செய்பவர்க்கும் அரண் சிறந்த செல்வமாகும்; பகைவர்க்கு அஞ்சித் தம்மைப் பாதுகாத்துக் கொள்பவர்க்கும் அது சிறந்த செல்வமாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights the dual utility of a fortress. For the aggressors (ஆற்றுபவர், here meaning those capable of waging war), a fortress serves as a secure base from which to launch attacks and consolidate power. For the defenders (அஞ்சித் தற்போற்றுபவர்), it provides a safe refuge to protect themselves from enemies. The word பொருள் (wealth/asset) is used twice to emphasize that a fortress is of ultimate value to both the strong who attack and the weak who defend.

ai.literal: Crystal water and, open land and, mountain and, beautiful shade forest and, that which possesses [is] a fortress.
ai.translation: A true fortress is one that possesses clear waters, open land, mountains, and beautiful shaded forests.
ai.modern: தெளிவான நீரும், வெட்டவெளியான நிலமும், மலையும், அழகிய நிழலைத் தரும் காடும் ஆகிய நான்கையும் உடையதே சிறந்த அரண் ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the natural components of a strong fortress. It lists four essential features: clear waters for drinking and defense, open land for clear visibility, mountains as natural barriers, and dense forests for cover. The word 'அணிநிழற்' emphasizes the thick, beautiful shade of the forest, which provides both resources and concealment. Together, these elements form an impenetrable natural defense.

ai.literal: Height, width, strength, difficulty: of these four, the possessing is a fortress, thus declares the treatise.
ai.translation: Treatises on strategy declare that a true fortress possesses these four qualities: height, breadth, strength, and inaccessibility.
ai.modern: உயர்வு, அகலம், உறுதி, பகைவரால் அழிக்க முடியாத அருமை ஆகிய இந்த நான்கும் அமைந்திருப்பதே சிறந்த அரண் என்று நூல்கள் கூறும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the essential physical characteristics of a good fortress. The four key attributes are height to prevent scaling, breadth to accommodate defenders and supplies, strength to withstand attacks, and inaccessibility to make it difficult for enemies to approach. The word 'நூல்' refers to treatises on statecraft and military strategy, indicating that this definition is based on established strategic principles.

ai.literal: Small in defense, large in space having become, pressing enemy's vigor that which destroys is a fortress.
ai.translation: A true fortress requires only a small defense while holding a vast interior space, and it shatters the vigor of attacking enemies.
ai.modern: காப்பதற்குச் சிறிய எல்லையையும், உள்ளே தங்குவதற்குப் பெரிய இடத்தையும் கொண்டு, தன்னை எதிர்த்து வரும் பகையின் ஊக்கத்தை அழிப்பதே சிறந்த அரணாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the ideal proportions and psychological impact of a fortress. It should have a narrow or easily defensible perimeter to minimize the effort of guarding it, yet possess a spacious interior to hold defenders and resources. Furthermore, its formidable nature must break the spirit and enthusiasm of any besieging enemy before they even strike.

ai.literal: Difficult for capturing, having contained provisions, for the position of those inside being easy, of such nature is a fortress.
ai.translation: A true fortress is difficult for enemies to capture, holds ample provisions, and is easy for those inside to defend.
ai.modern: பகைவரால் கைப்பற்ற முடியாததாகவும், உள்ளே இருப்பவர்களுக்குத் தேவையான உணவை உடையதாகவும், உள்ளிருப்போர் தங்கிப் போரிடுவதற்கு எளிமையானதாகவும் இருப்பதே சிறந்த அரணாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the three essential qualities of a good fortress. First, it must be impregnable to enemies trying to capture it from the outside. Second, it must be well-stocked with provisions to withstand long sieges. Third, it must be structurally advantageous, making it easy for the defenders inside to hold their ground. The word 'நீர்' here refers to the 'nature' or 'quality' of the fortress, rather than its common meaning of water.

ai.explanation: This couplet defines the two most critical internal assets of a fortress: material supplies and human resources. The phrase 'எல்லாப் பொருளும் உடைத்தாய்' emphasizes that the fort must be self-sufficient, holding all necessary provisions to withstand a long siege. Furthermore, 'இடத்து உதவும் நல்லாள்' highlights the need for capable and loyal defenders who will fight effectively when the situation demands it. A true fortress is defined by possessing both these material and human strengths.

ai.literal: Even having besieged, without besieging even having attacked, even causing treachery, to capture it is difficult, a fortress.
ai.translation: A true fortress is one that is difficult to capture whether the enemy lays a complete siege, storms it directly, or attempts to breach it through treachery.
ai.modern: பகைவர்கள் முற்றுகையிட்டாலும், முற்றுகையிடாமல் நேரடியாகத் தாக்கினாலும், உள்ளிருப்போரை வஞ்சித்துச் சதி செய்தாலும், கைப்பற்றுவதற்கு அரியதே சிறந்த அரணாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate resilience of a good fortress against various military tactics. It states that a fort must withstand a prolonged siege, a sudden direct assault, and internal treachery or breaches. The words 'முற்றியும்' (besieging), 'எறிந்தும்' (storming), and 'அறைப்படுத்தும்' (causing treachery) cover the three main ways an enemy might try to take a fort. A true fortress remains impenetrable and difficult to capture despite all these threats.

ai.literal: All having gathered, even those who besieged, position having secured, those who held defeating, (is) a fortress.
ai.translation: A true fortress enables its defenders, holding their secure positions, to defeat even enemies who have laid siege with all their gathered might.
ai.modern: தமக்குரிய இடத்தின் வலிமையை நிலைநிறுத்தி உள்ளே இருப்பவர்கள், தம் முழு வலிமையையும் திரட்டி முற்றுகையிட்ட பகைவரையும் வெல்ல உதவுவதே சிறந்த அரணாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate defensive power of a fortress. The phrase 'முற்று ஆற்றி முற்றியவர்' refers to enemies who have gathered all their strength to lay a complete siege. Against them, 'பற்று ஆற்றி பற்றியார்' describes the defenders who firmly secure their position inside. A true fortress is one that allows these defenders to defeat such a massive, well-prepared besieging force.

ai.literal: At the battle front / foes / to fall / at the face of action / greatness / having attained / that which is glorious / [is] a fortress.
ai.translation: A true fortress is glorious, achieving greatness in its defensive actions so that foes fall at the battle front.
ai.modern: போர் முனையில் பகைவர்கள் அழியும்படி, தான் செய்யும் போர்ச் செயல்களில் சிறப்படைந்து மாட்சிமைப்பட்டிருப்பதே சிறந்த அரணாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the active, combative purpose of a fortress. It is not merely a passive wall, but a strategic base that must facilitate the defeat of enemies ('மாற்றலர் சாய'). The phrase 'வினைமுகத்து வீறு எய்தி' highlights the excellence required in executing defensive and offensive operations from within. Thus, a fortress is deemed truly glorious ('மாண்டது') only when it empowers its defenders to crush a siege at the battle front.

ai.literal: Of whatever greatness it is, even if, action-excellence those-who-lack-with, not-it-is, fortress.
ai.translation: Even if a fortress possesses every kind of greatness, it is nothing to those who lack excellence in action.
ai.modern: ஒரு கோட்டை எவ்வளவு பெருமைகளை உடையதாக இருந்தாலும், சிறந்த செயல் திறன் இல்லாதவர்களிடம் அது பயனில்லாதது ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes that the physical strength of a fortress is secondary to the capability of its defenders. The phrase 'எனைமாட்சித்து' (of whatever greatness) covers all the physical attributes a fortress might have, such as height, thickness, and provisions. 'வினைமாட்சி' means excellence in action or tactical execution. The word 'இல்லது' (it is not) strongly declares that without capable defenders, the fortress effectively ceases to exist as a defense. Thus, human effort and skill are the true foundation of any defense.
